models_input.contains: fitted pipeline, val-chosen threshold, best parameters
models_input.score: predict_proba for the laundering class; higher = more suspicious

test_views.note: test_full contains test_main, so the two views are not independent. Never add their counts together.

threshold_metrics.threshold_source: the threshold saved with each model (best F1)
threshold_metrics.test_rule: the saved threshold is used unchanged on test

ranking_metrics.budget_rule: alert the top ceil(0.01 * N) scores of the test view
ranking_metrics.report_ties: number of rows tied at the cut-off score that did not get an alert
ranking_metrics.label: batch-ranking comparison, not a live threshold guarantee

reference_models.ach_rule: flags every ACH payment (fixed rule, no threshold)

patterns_file.use: evaluation only, never for features or model training
patterns_file.ambiguous_matches: reported and left out, never picked at random
